content: {"rule": "K-G4", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D2 vs C3 (Matthew 1:18, 25): CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 \"before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost\" and Matthew 1:25 \"knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son\" contradict C3's claim of espousal union; [L2] πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν (prin ē synelthein, Strong's G4250/G4905, before coming together) and οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν (ouk eginōsken, Strong's G1097, was not knowing); [L3] Luke 1:34.", "why": "The judge breaks the challenger's link by counting Matthew 1:18, 25 and the bare citation Luke 1:34 against it, yet names no earlier round and quotes only scripture text rather than the sentence of the round that pressed those verses, so under K-G4 these verses cannot count as unanswered witnesses."}
